title: Conditional independence for a literal 451-state Turing machine
abstract: This formalization concerns a binary machine with 451 working states. Under consistency of ZF plus a Berkeley cardinal, arithmetic Σ₁-soundness of ZFC plus I₀, and a proof in ZF plus a Berkeley cardinal of consistency of the specified Craig presentation of the arithmetic consequences of ZFC plus I₀, the machine never halts on the blank tape and neither halting nor nonhalting is provable in ZFC plus I₀ or ZF plus I₀.
